description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductImageRemove' which extends 'ImageRemove' and declares methods for removing product images, either individually or for a whole product, in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductImageRemove
classes.description: An interface for removing product images, extending the general ImageRemove interface in the CMS module.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a specified product, possibly throwing a ServiceException.
